# Share feedback.
Tell us how we are doing. Compliments, suggestions, and concerns all reach management directly and help us serve your community better.

## Tell us how we are doing.
Name and email are optional, but we can only follow up if you share them.

- **[773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652)** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

- **[service@centerpointmgmt.com](mailto:service@centerpointmgmt.com)** Replies within one business day

- **5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S** Chicago, IL 60625

## What we do with feedback.
Every message is read by management. Suggestions about communication, maintenance, or how we run meetings shape how we work with your board. If you raise a concern and ask us to follow up, we reply within one business day.

Feedback is not the right channel for a repair or a rule issue. Use the [maintenance request](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/resources/maintenance-request) or [violation report](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/resources/report-a-violation) so it is logged and routed correctly.

## Common questions.

### Is my feedback anonymous?
The form opens an email from your own account, so we will see your email address. Leave your name blank if you prefer, and tell us if you do not want your comments shared with the board.

### Who reads it?
Management reads every message.

### Do you publish reviews?
No. We do not post feedback on this website.
